notes.title: Regency Solitaire II is now Steam Deck Verified
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce that due to our recent game update, Valve has now given Regency Solitaire II an official Green Tick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/62b977598fa2b3ef1185594634999aea2591eca9.jpg

What does it mean?
After each game is reviewed by Valve, it is categorized for its level of compatibility of Steam Deck. You’ll see these categories on Steam, when you’re browsing your library or shopping for games on Deck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/9de433813dcb08289dbb72dbe3f6054fe28c7e55.png
The green tick means not only is Regency Solitaire II playable on the Steam Deck, but it has been given the official seal of approval that it plays GREAT on Steam Deck!

Enjoy! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: V1.08 Includes Steam Deck Enhancements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/62b977598fa2b3ef1185594634999aea2591eca9.jpg
We are happy to share a game update that includes features to make the game play even better on Steam Deck!

Here are the details:

V1.08
Steam Deck enhancements:
- Tapping the wildcard fan will now bring up a wildcard selection panel to make it easier to select an individual wildcard.
- The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is prompted to enter their name.
- Boosted the font size in various places if running on Steam Deck.
- Replaced "Click to continue" on the first story dialog with "Tap to continue" and made it larger.
- Replaced "Click" in all tutorial text with "Tap".
- If "Exit Game" is used via the Steam button the game will no longer say "Sorry the game didn't close properly last time." on next boot.
- Hid the "Set as Wallpaper" button on Steam Deck because it's not applicable.

General:
- Improved Steam Cloud support so that the first time you play on another device it will pick the first profile in the profile list instead of using a blank profile.

V1.05-V1.07
- Game Name (on Window title bar) now includes Collector's Edition.
- Locked wallpapers now say "Locked" instead of "???"
- Deleted unused VO1a.ogg file
- Fixed an issue where the Resume Chapter dialog showed the wrong chapter number if you were previously playing a Collector's Edition chapter and had just loaded the game.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Behind-the-Scenes: Crafting the Grand Intro for Regency Solitaire II!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/fe4ccfa8b0858d3f65e9642d9384ac943b47fad4.jpg

Dear Regency aficionados,
Here's another sneak peek into the world of game development. We've been knee-deep in planning the intro movie for Regency Solitaire II, and it's been a rollercoaster incorporating both creativity and meticulous detail!

The planning phase is no joke. We've nailed down every background, character, and line of text through countless drafts. And now, Jake's mission is to "just" code it. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/5cf4b72d185a8108c72140cb3d29c968599cd0e7.jpg
This detailed plan helps him to catch potential hiccups before they become a reality. He's not starting entirely from scratch, either, but rather deploying some existing code used for the intro movie in the original Regency Solitaire, plus its prequel, Shadowhand. (It's all about saving time and brainpower.)

Perfecting the timing of pans, zooms, and syncing to voiceovers and music is no small feat. It's a puzzle of its own.

Why have an intro movie?
You might wonder, why go to all this trouble for an intro? For us, it's not just about meeting expectations; it's about creating an immersive experience for you, the players. While we could ship without an intro (Ancient Enemy didn't have one), we think it helps to set the tone. Plus the game has a 1 hour demo, so the intro can show off a lot more backgrounds and characters from later in the game, and look really fancy.

Remember the OG intro movie that set the stage for Regency Solitaire? We're still super proud of it, as it's a testament to the heart we pour into every detail:
[previewyoutube=_W2GM1ECbwU;full][/previewyoutube]
We'll be sharing the finished masterpiece on YouTube, social media, and right here on Steam. Because your support means a great deal to our small studio.

Coming soon...!
Get ready for more updates! We're gearing up to announce the launch date. And mark your calendars – on Feb 5th, 2024, during the Next Fest, you'll have the chance to try out a demo version of Regency Solitaire II on Steam. Don't miss it!

Thanks for being a part of this exciting adventure with us.

Jake & Helen, Grey Alien Games.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/9dbdf501fe8f2d0f9ac2a3dcb88a36a52dd0037b.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137470/Regency_Solitaire_II/

notes.title: Lovely Levels
notes.content:
We are crafting and curating our lovely levels! 

We were really pleased with this horseshoe design - did you know that whether a horseshoe is considered lucky displayed 'up' or 'down' varies in different cultures? We thought we would do both, and hope that it brings our story's secret lovers some extra luck…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/76d4e15db74000ec1d6dbcdad681cb11fabe9736.jpg

Most of all, we are checking for FUN so that every level has that ‘I’ll play just one more hand…’ feeling.

Regency Solitaire II is coming to Steam early next year – we would love you to wishlist it and help us make it a success:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137470/Regency_Solitaire_II/


Did you know that we are a small, husband-and-wife team based in the UK?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/9dbdf501fe8f2d0f9ac2a3dcb88a36a52dd0037b.jpg

Thanks for reading and supporting our game!

notes.title: Peruse our dev diaries!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/e18158d73ec82e0ec8940b8f693946f1b7771a93.gif

Interested in our development progress / process for Regency Solitaire II?

We have a series of detailed posts here on our progress. 

a few highlights...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/d6b8eda4701eaf931deeebd5171abe92c9fbedf2.png
Since Regency Solitaire, we've doubled the amount of power ups, which led to us designing this new UI

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/33d126eae2b58ae658a70956cda746eaf67a94c8.gif
Here's our Pall Mall mallet in action

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/98f3a109b51af6c52f1cdd2496dbe0335fe08ddf.jpg
Bella has many delectable new wardrobe items to collect. What's more, she is creating a new landscaped garden, with the help of an up-and-coming garden designer, Maplethorpe Green.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/8cb9d3b9ba9375ae5b21661c8ff2305bb838c71c.jpg
...and of course there is a new romance story, filled with intrigue and played out across lavish historical locations around Britain.

...wait, there's even more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/7e54dfc56768b843b9d627ccba6655e66038a3ef.png
The gossip sheets will certainly be buzzing with an entire extra romance story and other bonus features which unlock once you finish the main game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351606/a596bdacfbc2527a9bdce0ebcbb74c8da7187066.png

This is just a whirlwind tour: You can learn much more about the sumptuous details and diversions we have included, and of course lots of technical info about design, music, sound, code...

So we would love to invite you to dive in to our developer diaries here.

And don't forget to wishlist Regency Solitaire II and tell your friends!
